name: Jian Hao Lim
bio:
Jian Hao discovered his passion for motorsport while helping his uncle repair motorcycles in his youth. This early experience with mechanics led him to pursue a degree in engineering, with a specialization in composite materials. After graduating, he worked for a local aerospace company, honing his skills in carbon fiber and other advanced materials before making the jump to motorsport. He joined Praga Racing five years ago and has been instrumental in improving the structural integrity and performance of their cars.

Jian Hao is known for his meticulous approach to his work. He believes in thorough planning and precise execution, ensuring that every component meets the highest standards. He constantly seeks new ways to improve the performance of the cars by experimenting with different materials and techniques. His ambition drives him to stay ahead of the curve in the ever-evolving world of motorsport technology. He is particularly adept at understanding the interplay between aerodynamics and structural integrity, allowing him to optimize designs for both speed and safety.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jian Hao is of average height with a lean build, reflecting his active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of microfiber cloth for cleaning composite surfaces.
